statement: Hand derivation for the published random-labelled single-relation route: independent partite positive zero-sum events have exact second moments giving existence at least L/(r+L-1); rejecting bad abscissas loses at most (mb)^2/r. Label-free recovery needs no final matrix. The named complete direct monomial-index architecture has at least r/m! columns when b^m>=r, so its allocation is exponential at balanced m. No fast selector, full probability formalization or complete subexponential algorithm is supplied.
